title.value: Hackmamba: Developer Experience, the New Way

summary.value: Guest on Hackmamba's "Everything Outside Code" series - exploring how AI is reshaping Developer Experience, what that shift means for Developer Relations teams, and how CKEditor fits into the new landscape where tooling expectations have fundamentally changed.

value.description: Hackmamba: Developer Experience, the New Way

content.value:
What we talked about

Hackmamba's "Everything Outside Code" series covers the softer side of software: community, DevRel, developer experience, and the ecosystem work that makes or breaks adoption. This episode touched on how AI is changing every assumption about what good DX looks like.

  • Developer Experience in the AI era - how AI-assisted coding changes what developers expect from documentation, SDKs, and tooling. The bar for friction tolerance has dropped to near zero.
  • The shift in Developer Relations - what DevRel looks like when developers are co-writing code with an AI assistant. Less "how to" content, more "why this" content. More emphasis on correctness and context.
  • CKEditor's position - what it means to maintain a developer-facing tool that itself gets used inside AI-powered applications, and how that shapes the product and the DevRel strategy.
